name: Echo Ridge Mine
summary: Kobolds hold Echo Ridge Mine in the northwestern cliffs of Northshire Valley, where stone and ore once fed the valley.

sections.title: A Foothold for Vermin
sections.body: Echo Ridge Mine was cut into the hills above Northshire Abbey to supply the valley with stone and metal. Kobolds poured through its tunnels and drove out the workers. Marshal McBride fears they endanger Northshire's safety and its recruits. So he sends new recruits into the mine to thin their numbers and take it back.

sections.title: The Threat Beneath Northshire
sections.body: Kobolds have pushed beyond Echo Ridge Mine into Elwynn Forest. From the northwestern ridge, they threaten Northshire's training grounds and the flow of resources to the abbey.

faq.q: Why are kobolds in Echo Ridge Mine?
faq.answer: Kobolds burrow into dark tunnels rich in minerals. Echo Ridge Mine's defenses were weak, so they overran it and now dig for treasure while claiming the tunnels as their own.

faq.q: Who is trying to reclaim Echo Ridge Mine?
faq.answer: Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey leads the effort to clear Echo Ridge Mine. He sends newly arrived adventurers to scout its tunnels and thin the kobold numbers before they spread farther into the valley.

faq.q: Where is Echo Ridge Mine located?
faq.answer: Echo Ridge Mine's entrance lies in Northshire Valley's northwestern corner, cut into the rocky hillside just north of the abbey vineyards.

angles.text: Echo Ridge Mine's shafts hold mineral deposits, but prospectors must fight through the candle-bearing kobolds to reach the ore.
As a human answering Stormwind's call, you help clear Echo Ridge Mine and defend Northshire Abbey.
